Native dialog (mocked) In production, secret entry is delegated to the OS — zenity --password on Linux, CredUIPromptForWindowsCredentials on Windows. The webview never sees plaintext (DESIGN.md §8.2). The fields below are visual mocks only.
Passphrase
Recovery key

Type or paste the 96-digit key. Dashes, spaces, and dots are accepted (parser is liberal — see RecoveryKey::decode()).

96 digits expected; each 6-digit group must be divisible by 11.
